summary: Webuy Global disclosed receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter dated September 14, 2026, warning that its Class A ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (July 31–September 11, 2026), breaching Rule 5550(a)(2). The deficiency is not immediate delisting; WBUY continues trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company has until March 15, 2027 to regain compliance via ten consecutive $1.00 closes, typically through a reverse split completed at least ten business days prior. A drop to $0.10 or less for ten sessions triggers delisting; watch for split timing and second-period eligibility.
